ideal: Each thread opens a draft pull request, stays under an hour idle, and costs fewer tokens per merged pull request each week.

sources.title: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Use Claude Code in the cloud

quality: Every thread opens its pull request as a draft, as the Projects docs' example instructions say.
speed: A thread starts from the project's instructions, so no rule is restated to it.
consumption: A thread idle past the one-hour cache lifetime is replaced by a fresh one, and tokens per merged pull request fall.
